name.en: Quadruped Trunk Rotation with Arm Opening

purpose.zh: 活动上背旋转，打开胸部
purpose.en: Mobilize upper-back rotation and open the chest.

text.zh: 一手撑地，另一臂向天花板打开
text.en: Keep one hand down and open your other arm toward the ceiling
Follow your hand with your eyes and turn your chest open.
Keep your hips still, then bring the arm back slowly.

commonErrors.en: Shifting the hips to one side.
Twisting from the lower back instead of the upper back.

cautions.zh: 只拉到舒适的程度，出现疼痛就放松
cautions.en: Stretch only to a comfortable point, and ease off if anything hurts.

cautions.zh: 先做手腕热身；手腕刺痛或发麻就停止
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists first, and stop if they feel sharp pain or numbness.
